# Watercolor Affair

> A comprehensive watercolor learning platform by Anthony Roebuck offering courses, tutorials, and techniques for artists of all levels.

Watercolor Affair provides structured online courses, detailed guides on painting techniques and color theory, and curated resources for watercolor supplies. The site is built around Anthony Roebuck's teaching philosophy and features masterclasses with lifetime access, color mixing systems, and practical tutorials for beginners through advanced artists.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Beginner guides
- Color mixing and theory
- Watercolor techniques
- Online courses
- Water control and wet-on-wet
- Blending techniques
- Watercolor supplies
- Art tutorials
- Watercolor Masterclass
- Brushes and paper selection
- Portrait painting
- Pigments and paints
- Art education
- Painting fundamentals

## Courses & Learning

- [Courses](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/courses): Catalog of online watercolor courses and masterclasses.
- [Watercolor Masterclass for Beginners](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-masterclass-for-beginners): Main beginner watercolor course with lifetime access and feedback.
- [Color Mixing Success](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/color-mixing-success): Color Mixing Success course featuring color maps system.
- [Shop](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/shop): Main shop page featuring Watercolor Masterclass and other courses.

## Watercolor Fundamentals

- [Watercolor for Beginners](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-for-beginners): Step-by-step guides and lessons for beginner watercolor artists.
- [Watercolor Techniques](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-techniques): Tutorials on blending, dry-brush, glazing, and watercolor effects.
- [Watercolor Mixing](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-mixing): Color theory and mixing principles for watercolor painting.
- [Drawing](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/drawing): Drawing techniques and image transfer methods for watercolor art.

## Supplies & Materials Reference

- [Watercolor Paints](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-supplies/paints): Guide to watercolor paints, pigments, and paint selection.
- [Watercolor Paper](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-supplies/paper): Comprehensive guide to watercolor paper selection and properties.
- [Watercolor Brushes](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/watercolor-supplies/brushes): Reference on brush types, care, and handling techniques.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.watercoloraffair.com/blog): Blog hub with painting tips, tutorials, and watercolor inspiration.
